probe_notes: Sixth run. No dimension-level score changes across all 7 vendors vs 2026-05-11 baseline. Doc-only probe throughout. Shapeways stable: upload-to-price, POST /orders/v1 with credit_card, polling-only status, self-serve OAuth at auth.shapeways.com; developer landing page confirms 5% per-transaction fee on part orders (first documented this run). PCBWay stable: PcbQuotation + SMTQuotation synchronous, five-step order flow with pre-loaded balance, QueryOrderProcess polling, no webhooks, no DFM. JLCPCB help article returned thin content — prior confirmed data stands: real-time quoting exists, full spec gated behind approved developer access, three-credential auth system. Xometry: llms.txt index probed for first time this run — confirms Job/Offers/Webhooks API scope remains entirely supplier-side; webhooks infrastructure (create/retrieve/update/archive) confirmed but purpose is job-routing to manufacturing partners, not buyer order tracking; Offers API is supplier accept/reject, not buyer ordering; no buyer-facing quoting API in any indexed page. Hubs: hubs.com/api/ 404 again — Protolabs Network landing page returned, no developer docs. Protolabs: still no public REST API, ProDesk UI-only confirmed. Fictiv: fictiv.com/api 404 again. Leaderboard: Shapeways 88 / PCBWay 65 / JLCPCB 38.

instant_quote.notes: POST /models/v1 accepts STL/OBJ/VOX file upload with fileName + uploadScale params. Returns modelId after async processing; pricing retrieved via GET /models/{modelId}/v1 with per-material price fields. Upload-to-price flow confirmed stable this run.

structured_pricing.notes: Material objects in GET /models/{modelId}/v1 response include 'price' (float, USD), 'markup' (float), 'isActive' (bool) keyed by materialId. defaultMaterialId designated. Fully parseable JSON. Confirmed stable.

api_order.notes: POST /orders/v1 documented: shipping address, items array (modelId + materialId + quantity), paymentMethod: 'credit_card' using card on file, manufacturingSpeed ('Economy'/'Priority'), shippingOption ('Cheapest'/'Fastest'). Returns orderId and productionOrderIds. Full order including payment via API — no browser step required. Developer landing confirms 5% per-transaction fee charged on orders placed through API. Stable.

order_status.notes: GET /orders/{orderId}/v1 returns status (placed/in_production/shipped/cancelled), targetDeliveryDate, shipments array with trackingNumber + trackingLink + carrier. GET /orders/v1 returns summary counts by status. No webhook support documented — confirmed absent this run. Polling-only.

auth_accessibility.notes: OAuth 2.0 self-serve via auth.shapeways.com/register. Two flows: client_credentials and authorization_code. No approval gate — standard sign-up. Developer landing confirms API access is free (5% per-transaction fee applies to orders placed). Confirmed stable.

rate_limits.notes: No rate limit documentation found anywhere in public docs. Confirmed absent this run.

dfm_feedback.notes: Model detail response includes 'printable' field; 'restrictions' object with material-specific constraints (restrictionId, restrictionName, restrictionEntityIds); upload response contains validation feedback. Structured DFM feedback in API response confirmed stable.

ttfq_speed.notes: Upload and processing are async — pricing available after model processing completes. No documented SLA. Async implies minutes range. Scoring 3 pts pending live probe confirmation. Stable.

notable_changes: Developer landing page confirms 5% per-transaction fee on API-placed orders — first documented this run (score unchanged, context enriched)

instant_quote.notes: POST api/Pcb/PcbQuotation — parameter-based synchronous quoting endpoint. Pass board specs (dimensions, layers, material, surface finish, quantity) and receive priceList[] array immediately. POST api/SMT/SMTQuotation also confirmed — SMT assembly quoting extends coverage. Full endpoint list confirmed stable this run: PcbQuotation, PlaceOrder, ConfirmOrder, CheckOrderDetails, GetFreightByOrder, QueryOrderProcess, CancelOrder. Stable.

structured_pricing.notes: Response includes priceList[] with objects containing BuildDays (int), BuildText (string), Express (bool), Standard (bool), Price (decimal). Shipping struct: ShipCost, ShipDays, Weight, IsRas. Fully documented JSON schema. Stable.

api_order.notes: Five-step documented flow: (1) PcbQuotation, (2) PlaceOrder with Gerber file upload, (3) GetFreightByOrder, (4) ConfirmOrder. Payment: 'Pay to Partner' (pre-loaded account balance, fully automated) or 'Pay to PCBWay' (returns PCBWayPayUrl — web redirect). Full automation requires pre-loaded balance; web redirect fallback limits score to 10. Stable.

order_status.notes: POST api/Pcb/QueryOrderProcess returns AllProcess[] (all fabrication stages) and List[] of completed stages with timestamps. POST api/Pcb/CheckOrderDetails also available. No webhooks documented. Stable.

auth_accessibility.notes: Static API key in 'api-key' header. Access requires emailing anson@pcbway.com with company/business context — API key on request, not self-serve. Stable.

rate_limits.notes: Not publicly documented in partner docs. Confirmed absent this run.

dfm_feedback.notes: No DFM feedback in API responses. Quote returns price only. DFM checks happen post-order, communicated out-of-band via email. Confirmed absent.

ttfq_speed.notes: PcbQuotation is synchronous — single POST returns price array immediately. Under 1 minute by architecture. Confirmed stable.

instant_quote.notes: PCB API described as supporting Gerber file uploads, automated pricing, order creation, and production tracking at api.jlcpcb.com. Help center confirms 'real-time quotations.' Full endpoint spec gated behind approved developer access. Help article page returned thin content this run — prior confirmed data stands.

structured_pricing.notes: Automated pricing confirmed at capability level but actual JSON response schema fully gated behind approved developer access. Cannot verify structured fields without approved account. Scoring 0 per probe rule: no verifiable citation.

api_order.notes: Order creation endpoint exists but payment requires JLCPCB wallet balance pre-loaded — not a general payment API. Full endpoint spec gated. Cannot confirm automated end-to-end without approved access.

order_status.notes: Described as 'comprehensive order lifecycle management with real-time status tracking.' Mechanism (webhook vs polling) not publicly documented. Scoring polling-level (10 pts) pending webhook confirmation. Stable.

auth_accessibility.notes: Three-credential system: app_id + access_key + secret_key with RSA key pair. Application submitted at api.jlcpcb.com — reviewed based on order history and business circumstances. Not all applications approved. Classifies as 'API key on request'. Stable.

rate_limits.notes: Not publicly documented. Gated behind approved access. Stable.

dfm_feedback.notes: JLCDFM exists as a separate tool (jlcdfm.com) — not integrated into API quote response. No public documentation of DFM fields in API responses. Stable.

ttfq_speed.notes: Described as 'real-time' quotations. No specific SLA documented. Scoring 3 pts (1 min to 1 hr) — 'real-time' implies async-but-fast rather than human-review-gated. Stable.

instant_quote.notes: Xometry llms.txt API index probed this run — confirms Jobs/Offers/Webhooks as the full API surface. No buyer-facing CAD upload or instant quote API exists. Offers API is supplier accept/reject interface for manufacturing jobs routed by Xometry. No change.

structured_pricing.notes: No buyer-facing pricing API exists. Pricing returned only through Xometry web UI quoting flow. Confirmed stable via llms.txt index this run.

api_order.notes: No buyer-facing order placement API. Jobs API is inbound (Xometry pushes jobs to partner shops). Enterprise buyer integration requires partner agreement. Stable.

order_status.notes: Webhooks API confirmed this run via llms.txt (create/retrieve/update/archive/unarchive webhooks, retrieve + retry webhook events) — but these are SUPPLIER-side webhooks for job routing to manufacturing partners, not buyer order tracking. No buyer-facing status endpoint. Stable.

auth_accessibility.notes: API key via X-API-Key header. Keys for supplier/partner portal accessible without sales call. Job Board Offers requires explicit approval via email to support@xometry.com. Scoring 5 pts as 'API key on request' mechanism — correct path but wrong audience for buyers.

rate_limits.notes: Not documented in any accessible page. Confirmed absent via llms.txt index this run.

dfm_feedback.notes: DFM feedback delivered through Xometry web UI only. Not present in any indexed API endpoint. Stable.

ttfq_speed.notes: No buyer-facing quoting API to measure. Stable.

notable_changes: Xometry llms.txt index probed for first time this run — confirms full API surface is Jobs + Offers (supplier-side) + Webhooks (supplier-side job events); no buyer-facing endpoints in scope (score unchanged, confidence improved)
